```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
```

libraries
```{r : reading libraries, include= FALSE}
packages <- c("tidyverse", "readxl", "dplyr", "magrittr", "mixtools", "emmeans", "readr","data.table", "lubridate", "ggplot2", "skimr", "ggstatsplot","summarytools", "knitr", "here", "ggthemes", "Amelia", "tidyr", "naniar", "stringr", "janitor", "ggbreak", "patchwork", "plotrix", "viridis", "hrbrthemes", "showtext")

lapply(packages, library, character.only = TRUE)
```

```{r : set up #2}
# read in data
all_data <- read.csv("Outputs/Dataframe outputs/all_data_Nov22_Feb25.csv", header=T, na.strings= c("", "NA"))

# remove NA patient
all_data <- all_data[all_data$Sex.at.birth != "Not Assigned",]

# colours
myColours <- c("purple", "lightblue", "grey")

# add font
font_add(family = "Arial", regular = "Arial.ttf")

all_data$Centre.ID.x <- as.factor(all_data$Centre.ID.x)
```

```{r : violin plots}
BMI_violin <- ggplot(all_data, aes(x = Sex.at.birth, y = BMI, fill = Sex.at.birth)) +
  geom_violin() +
  theme_classic() +
  ylim(20, 70) +
  ggtitle("BMI 22-25") +
  geom_point(position = position_jitter(seed = 1, width = 0.2))

Age_violin <- ggplot(all_data, aes(x = Sex.at.birth, y = Age, fill = Sex.at.birth)) +
  geom_violin() +
  theme_classic() +
  scale_y_continuous(breaks = seq(0, 90, by = 5)) +
  ggtitle("Age 22-25") +
  geom_point(position = position_jitter(seed = 1, width = 0.2))

Weight_violin <- ggplot(all_data, aes(x = Sex.at.birth, y = Weight..kg., fill = Sex.at.birth)) +
  geom_violin() +
  theme_classic() +
  scale_y_continuous(breaks = seq(45, 160, by = 5)) +
  ggtitle("Weight 22-25") +
  geom_point(position = position_jitter(seed = 1, width = 0.2))

Height_violin <- ggplot(all_data, aes(x = Sex.at.birth, y = Height..cm., fill = Sex.at.birth)) +
  geom_violin() +
  theme_classic() +
  ylim(140,195) +
  ggtitle("Height 22-25") +
  geom_point(position = position_jitter(seed = 1, width = 0.2))

BP_systolic_violin <- ggplot(all_data, aes(x = Sex.at.birth, y = Systolic.Blood.Pressure, fill = Sex.at.birth)) +
  geom_violin() +
  theme_classic() +
  scale_y_continuous(breaks = seq(80, 180, by = 10)) +
  ggtitle("Systolic blood pressure (mmHg) 22-25") +
  geom_point(position = position_jitter(seed = 1, width = 0.2))

BP_diastolic_violin <- ggplot(all_data, aes(x = Sex.at.birth, y = Diastolic.Blood.Pressure, fill = Sex.at.birth)) +
  geom_violin() +
  theme_classic() +
  scale_y_continuous(breaks = seq(45, 110, by = 10)) +
  ggtitle("Diastolic blood pressure (mmHg) 22-25")  +
  geom_point(position = position_jitter(seed = 1, width = 0.2))

OHP_violin <- ggplot(all_data, aes(x = Sex.at.birth, y = `X17.OHP.value`, fill = Sex.at.birth)) +
  geom_violin() +
  theme_classic() +
  ggtitle("17OHP concentrations 22-25") +
  geom_point(position = position_jitter(seed = 1, width = 0.2)) +
  scale_y_continuous(trans = "log10") +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 30, colour = "red") +
  annotate('rect', xmin=-Inf, xmax=Inf, ymin=10, ymax=36, alpha=.5, fill='grey')

andro_violin <- ggplot(all_data, aes(x = Sex.at.birth, y = Androstenedione.value, fill = Sex.at.birth)) +
  geom_violin() +
  theme_classic() +
  ggtitle("Androstenedione concentrations") +
  geom_point(position = position_jitter(seed = 1, width = 0.2)) +
  scale_y_break(c(10,30,55,70), scale = 0.25) +
  scale_y_continuous(breaks = seq(0, 70, by = 2)) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 8, colour = "red")

testosterone_violin <- ggplot(all_data, aes(x = Sex.at.birth, y = `Total.testosterone.value`, fill = Sex.at.birth)) +
  geom_violin() +
  theme_classic() +
  ggtitle("Testosterone concentrations") +
  geom_point(position = position_jitter(seed = 1, width = 0.2)) +
  scale_y_continuous(breaks = seq(0, 30, by = 2.5))

renin_violin <- ggplot(all_data, aes(x = Sex.at.birth, y = Renin.plasma.activity, fill = Sex.at.birth)) +
  geom_violin() +
  theme_classic() +
  ggtitle("Renin plasma activity") +
  geom_point(position = position_jitter(seed = 1, width = 0.2)) +
  scale_y_break(c(55, 100), scale = 0.25)
```

```{r : biomarker plots}
# have played around with various axis breaks and y scales to get data to look as clear as possible...
## testosterone
testosterone_all <- MDBoxPlot(all_data, "Total.testosterone.value", "NTEO", "Testosterone 22-25") +
  scale_y_continuous(breaks = seq(0, 30, by = 2.5))

## renin plasma activity
renin_all <- MDBoxPlot(all_data, "Renin.plasma.activity", "SBS", "Renin plasma activiy") +
scale_y_break(c(40, 100), scale = 0.25)

## 17OHP
OHP_all <- MDBoxPlot(all_data, "X17.OHP.value", "NTEO", "17 OHP values 22-25") +
  scale_y_continuous(trans = "log10")  +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 30, colour = "red") +
  annotate('rect', xmin=-Inf, xmax=Inf, ymin=10, ymax=36, alpha=.5, fill='grey')

##andro
andro_all <- MDBoxPlot(all_data, "Androstenedione.value", "NTEO", "Andro values") +
  scale_y_break(c(20, 74), scale = 0.1) + 
  scale_y_continuous(breaks = seq(0, 75, by = 2)) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 8, colour = "red")
```
